description.narrative: Source: Start Fund Project Report FormsAssumptions: Decision-making is unbiased and driven by affected population needs over organizational benefit. SFN members prioritise decision making meeting and are available on time. Familiarity and confidence in Start Fund mechanism: standard and anticipation window. Speed of distribution of funds – arriving in accounts. Timely raising of alert notes. Availability of data/insight. SFN awarded agencies access the project intervention areas. Political conflict, election, festival time and other risks are not impacting the response timing. Federal, provincial and local government support and provide favorable environment for effective response.

description.narrative: Source: SFN members engagement tracker/ Allocation and PSC meeting minutesAssumptions: Local and National NGO responders in locations (or able to move to them) to respond to most frequent crises. Agencies have equal weighting of decisions and equitable weighting of opportunity. Agencies make available time to perform Governance functions. LNNGOs complete the due diligence assessments and are eligible to access funding. LNNGOs are operational in the areas where alerts are raised. LNNGOs submit proposals when the SF is activated. LNNGO proposals are selected by the project selection committee. Donor openness: reassessment, due diligence and capacity/development of NGOs to meet requirements. Donors are interested and have available funding to support pooled funding mechanism.

Target Phase III: Allocation meetings: 52%. Project selection meetings: 50%
